text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Diese Abkommen schaffen zwischen der Schweiz und der EU in verschiedenen Bereichen binnenmarktähnliche Verhältnisse, wodurch Handelshemmnisse und Diskriminierungen im gegenseitigen Wirtschaftsaustausch verringert oder abgebaut werden.", "gist": "Swiss-EU agreements create single-market-like conditions, reducing trade barriers and discrimination in mutual economic exchange."}, {"type": "number", "quote": "sieben Abkommen", "gist": "seven agreements"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "neun Abkommen", "gist": "nine agreements"}, {"type": "date", "quote": "1972", "gist": "1972"}, {"type": "date", "quote": "1992", "gist": "1992"}, {"type": "date", "quote": "1999", "gist": "1999"}, {"type": "date", "quote": "2004", "gist": "2004"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Europäischen Wirtschaftsraum (EWR)", "gist": "European Economic Area (EEA)"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Bilateralen I", "gist": "Bilateral I agreements"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Bilateralen II", "gist": "Bilateral II agreements"}]}
